noticias.titular: Yankees honor CC Sabathia with Monument Park plaque, number retirement
noticias.texto: The New York Yankees honored CC Sabathia with a plaque in Monument Park and retired his No. 52 jersey Friday.

noticias.titular: Dodgers' Ohtani 1st to top MLB jersey sales 4 straight seasons
noticias.texto: The Dodgers' Shohei Ohtani has become the first player in the MLB to lead jersey sales at the end of four straight seasons since the figures were first tracked in 2010.
